Core Business Focus
Grifols is a global healthcare company that focuses primarily on:
Grifols Diagnostic Solutions
Biopharma:
Producing plasma-derived medicines and therapies for immunology, neurology, and hematology.
Diagnostics:
Developing transfusion medicine tools, blood-typing analyzers, and laboratory testing equipment.
Hospital Solutions:
Providing hospital pharmacy automation, clinical nutrition, and intravenous solutions, rather than external or digital wearable monitors.

Grifols
does not make consumer or medical wearables
like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or remote patient monitoring tools. Grifols is a global healthcare and biopharmaceutical company that focuses on plasma-derived medicines, hospital pharmacy solutions, and transfusion medicine/diagnostic laboratory systems.
Grifols.com
What Grifols Actually Produces
Plasma-Derived Medicines:
Therapeutics manufactured from human plasma to treat rare, chronic, and life-threatening conditions.
Transfusion Medicine & Diagnostics:
Automated analyzers, blood-typing gel cards, and screening solutions for blood banks and clinical laboratories (such as the
Erytra
and
Procleix
systems).
Hospital Supplies:
Intravenous (IV) therapies, clinical nutrition delivery, and specialized medical instrumentation.
